acquisition method: For DDA experiments full MS resolutions were set to 60,000
alkylation reagent: followed by TCEP reduction, iodoacetamide (Sigma) alkylation, and trypsin (Promega) digestion
cleavage agent: incubated in ice-cold digestion solution (trypsin 12.5 ng/μl and 20 mM NH4HCO3)
collision energy: Normalized collision energy was set at 30%.
instrument: tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in Orbitrap Exploris 480 MS coupled online to the UPLC... analyses were performed on Thermo Q-Exactive instrument
ionization type: The peptides were subjected to NSI source followed by tandem mass spectrometry
labeling: Label-free quantification was also performed using the PEAKS Online X quantification module
reduction reagent: followed by TCEP reduction, iodoacetamide (Sigma) alkylation
